rationale: The last three 1-minute candles broke the higher-low consolidation pattern that existed at entry, produced successively lower lows to 429.51 on elevated volume, and pushed price beneath the 5-minute 9-EMA while unrealized P&L turned negative. Although the stock remains at 92.7% of the daily range and well above VWAP, the immediate post-earnings absorption has stalled with maximum favorable excursion limited to only 0.28%. These mechanical signs of short-term supply outweigh the still-constructive gap-fill and sector backdrop, warranting exit.
